title: [ingest] linkcheck HTTP 401 is broken by default; timeouts are not
summary: `linkcheck_allow_unauthorized` defaults to `False`, so HTTP 401 responses are reported as broken links. `linkcheck_report_timeouts_as_broken` also defaults to `False`, meaning timeouts get their own "timeout" status rather than "broken". Both are configurable but have counterintuitive defaults for documentation that links to auth-gated resources.
